label: Chevron Row
author: Conky-Studio
description: Row of chevrons that chase / light up. Good for directional flow or progress indication.
lua_draw_body:
local n = math.floor({count} + 0.5)
 local sz, gap = {size}, {gap}
 local val = math.min(tonumber({value}) or 0, 100) / 100
 local lit = val * n
 local r, g, b = {color}
 local phase = {animate} and (wall_clock() * {speed}) or 0
 for i = 0, n - 1 do
  local ox = {x} + i * (sz * 0.7 + gap)
  local oy = {y}
  local bright = 0.2
  if i < lit then bright = 0.55 + 0.45 * math.min(1, lit - i) end
  if {animate} then
   local wave = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(phase - i * 0.9)
   bright = bright * (0.55 + 0.45 * wave)
  end
  cairo_set_source_rgba(cr, r, g, b, {opacity} * bright)
  cairo_set_line_width(cr, 2.5)
  cairo_set_line_cap(cr, CAIRO_LINE_CAP_ROUND)
  cairo_set_line_join(cr, CAIRO_LINE_JOIN_ROUND)
  cairo_move_to(cr, ox, oy - sz/2)
  cairo_line_to(cr, ox + sz * 0.55, oy)
  cairo_line_to(cr, ox, oy + sz/2)
  cairo_stroke(cr)
 end
